item.title: PlayStation is encouraging PS4 players to upgrade to PS5 as analyst predicts PS6 won't arrive until after 2028
item.description: The games industry is in a very weird place right now due to both internal and external factors. Perhaps the most pressing one is the rising cost of key hardware components due to AI and data centre speculation. Therefore, next-gen hardware delays could be on the table as Sony and Microsoft look to maximize PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, respectively, while waiting markets to settle. Read more

item.title: "A design that would make anyone's heart throb" How Capcom turned Resident Evil Requiem's Leon S. Kennedy into a "hot uncle"
item.description: Many fans rushed to scream Leon S. Kennedy had aged like fine wine when he showed up in Resident Evil Requiem's December 2025 trailer. item.description: Scott Pilgrim vs. The World: The Game is a beat-em-up we've repeatedly gone back to over the years, always wishing there was a bit more meat and fluidity to it. Thankfully, developer (and publisher) Tribute Games seem to be delivering exactly that with Scott Pilgrim EX. Read more
